diagnosticHistory.note: The only failed check timed out while capturing the auxiliary phpMyAdmin window after login and database-tree assertions. It remains a failed diagnostic run.
The test used native NSIS unquoted /D syntax, while the installed builder template reparses D with StdUtils. The test invocation is corrected; This historical attempt did not accept the release.

The installer successfully placed the application into the exact requested path containing spaces. The installed executable matched the packaged executable SHA-256. The harness timed out waiting for the first application window before any E2E check ran; This historical attempt did not accept the release.
Installed payload integrity refused missing pgAdmin files; no bundled E2E ran.
Portable payload passed physical Node validation, but Electron ASAR virtual-directory handling rejected the unused pgAdmin archive before first window.
The early preparation gate refused PostgreSQL payload without its exact server notice; no distributable built.
Config reset encountered a transient Windows file sharing lock; all five native service checks worked.
